title: The Determinant Explained
direction: Clean & modern: warm off-white canvas, bold ink text, electric amber accent. Type is the visual. Color-coded diagonals: green = positive product, red = negative product. Every reveal is a deliberate spring-in — nothing drifts in, nothing fades passively.
